priorities.summary: VMware ESX contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the I/O filter service. Broadcom rated it Critical with a maximum CVSSv3 score of 9.8, and a network attacker can execute code on the host.
priorities.plain: Attackers who can reach a VMware ESX host could take control of it without logging in - install the fixed ESX build now.

priorities.summary: VMware ESX contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the I/O filter service. Broadcom rated it Critical with a maximum CVSSv3 score of 9.8, and a network attacker can execute code on the host.
priorities.plain: Attackers who can reach a VMware ESX host could take control of it without logging in - install the fixed ESX build now.

priorities.summary: BusyBox tftpd has an absolute path traversal vulnerability affecting versions through 1.38.0, rated CVSS 9.8 by NVD. An unauthenticated remote attacker can read or overwrite files on affected hosts.
priorities.plain: Attackers could read or replace files on systems running the BusyBox file service without logging in - update BusyBox and check if tftpd is on.

model.name: Qwen-Audio-3.1
model.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team expanded its hosted Qwen-Audio-3.1 voice models on November 26, with speech recognition now covering 59 languages, text-to-speech 65 languages and realtime conversation 53 languages. The update broadens multilingual voice support for production ASR, TTS and realtime endpoints.
model.plain: Voice AI that can listen and speak in many more languages, helping clients serve customers in their own language without building separate systems.
